claims: egress gate blocks restricted markers and unauthorized calls
ask returns typed answers with probabilities and hash-bound receipt
low confidence or transport failure fails closed with nonzero exit

cases.name: egress-gate-blocks-cui
command: cd skills/jev && echo '{"doc": "CUI// marked"}' > /tmp/jev_eval_cui.json && ./run.sh ask --preset edge_stance --state @/tmp/jev_eval_cui.json --allow-egress

cases.name: live-typed-judgment
command: source <(grep -E '^export JEV_API_KEY=' ~/.zshrc) && cd skills/jev && ./run.sh ask --preset triage_error --state '{"error":"The path argument must be of type string. Received undefined","context":"emit_message switchboard extension failed before its own logic ran"}' --allow-egress

cases.name: abstention-band-fails-closed
command: source <(grep -E '^export JEV_API_KEY=' ~/.zshrc) && cd skills/jev && JEV_ACCEPT_CONFIDENCE=0.99999 ./run.sh ask --preset edge_stance --state '{"claim":"the sky is often blue","passage":"Rain fell all week in Glasgow."}' --allow-egress
